title: ML↔BIZ-001: Model Accuracy vs. Market Requirements + Inference Cost vs. Pricing
description: The Edge AI/ML Engineer provides MCU/SoC (Microcontroller Unit / System-on-Chip) upgrade-cost implications of on-device ML inference, model-accuracy vs. BOM (Bill of Materials) cost trade-off options, and development-timeline and NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) estimates for edge-AI features; the Business Consultant provides the business case for AI/ML features (expected revenue premium, differentiation value, customer willingness-to-pay), the target inference-cost envelope (driven by hardware BOM constraints), and market requirements for AI capability (e.g., anomaly-detection latency, accuracy thresholds for the use case). Grounded in EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.9 and BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.4. Measure-first: ML never invents an accuracy figure — each value is disclosed as MEASURED or PROJECTED.

ml_cost_accuracy_options.description: ML→BIZ: accuracy/BOM-cost trade-off options, upgrade implications, timeline and NRE.

basis.description: Whether the figure is measured on target or projected (must be disclosed — measure-first).

market_ai_requirements.description: BIZ→ML: business case, target inference-cost envelope, and capability requirements.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine accuracy-vs-market and inference-cost-vs-pricing exchange for investment/pricing decisions is agent-autonomous. A cost-material AI investment or a BOM/MCU upgrade decision is escalated to an ADR + Business Impact Assessment; the binding investment decision is governance.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (at product concept stage; at feature-prioritization reviews; on-demand for AI investment decisions)
confirm_conditions: every model-accuracy figure carries a value, an explicit unit, and a disclosed basis (MEASURED vs. PROJECTED)
BOM-cost deltas and NRE carry a currency; the target inference-cost envelope carries a currency
capability requirements are BIZ-supplied with value + unit (not ML-invented)
MCU/SoC upgrade implications are stated for each trade-off option that needs one
reject_conditions: an accuracy figure presented as MEASURED without an on-target benchmark, or emitted with no basis (invented metric — measure-first)
an accuracy or capability value emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
an MCU/SoC platform upgrade decided across role boundaries without an ADR (Never Silently Deviate)
counter_conditions: a market accuracy threshold stated without measurement conditions — request the evaluation dataset/conditions before committing a trade-off
an inference-cost envelope supplied without the underlying BOM constraint — request the hardware envelope before sizing the model
